title: Jobs for the Next Generation
text:
Many experts predict that the labour market will change dramatically over the next two decades. Routine tasks, such as data entry and basic bookkeeping, are increasingly being automated by software. At the same time, new careers in fields like renewable energy and data science are expanding rapidly. As a result, workers will need to update their skills throughout their working lives.

Educational institutions are starting to adapt to these changes. Many now offer courses in programming, creative problem-solving and teamwork, which employers consider valuable in almost any profession. Some students also choose short professional certificates instead of traditional four-year degrees. According to the report, the most successful workers in the future will be those who stay curious and willing to learn.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is happening to routine tasks such as data entry?
options: They are being automated by software
They are becoming more popular with students
They are being moved to other countries

questions.text: What kinds of courses do many educational institutions now offer, according to the second paragraph?
What can be inferred about workers who want to succeed in the future?
options: They should avoid learning new skills
They should stay flexible and keep learning
They should work only in routine jobs
They should wait for employers to train them

questions.text: Why might some students prefer short professional certificates to traditional degrees?
options: They want to gain practical skills more quickly
They are not allowed to attend university
They dislike all forms of learning
They want to avoid working in any profession

paragraph_translations: Muchos expertos predicen que el mercado laboral cambiará drásticamente en las próximas dos décadas. Las tareas rutinarias, como la introducción de datos y la contabilidad básica, están siendo automatizadas cada vez más por software. Al mismo tiempo, las nuevas profesiones en campos como la energía renovable y la ciencia de datos se están expandiendo rápidamente. Como resultado, los trabajadores necesitarán actualizar sus habilidades a lo largo de su vida laboral.

Las instituciones educativas están empezando a adaptarse a estos cambios. Muchas ofrecen ahora cursos de programación, resolución creativa de problemas y trabajo en equipo, que los empleadores consideran valiosos en casi cualquier profesión. Algunos estudiantes también eligen certificados profesionales breves en lugar de títulos tradicionales de cuatro años. Según el informe, los trabajadores más exitosos del futuro serán quienes se mantengan curiosos y dispuestos a aprender.
